description: This file contains functions for discovering and connecting to Chrome browser instances over a network, including port checking, IP resolution, and auto-discovery mechanisms.

methods.name: isPortOpen
methods.description: Checks if a specific port on a host is open within a timeout.

methods.name: tryChromeHostUrl
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a Chrome debugging URL to verify if Chrome is accessible at that URL.

methods.name: getDockerHostIP
methods.description: Resolves the Docker host IP address, primarily for Docker Desktop environments.

methods.name: scanNetworkForChrome
methods.description: Scans a network range for open Chrome debugging ports on common IP addresses.

methods.name: discoverChromeHostUrl
methods.description: Discovers Chrome instances on the network by trying local, localhost, and auto-discovery.
